dct_title_s: IOM Bangladesh - Needs and Population Monitoring (NPM) Drone imagery and GIS package by camp (November 2018)
dct_description_sm: NPM Bangladesh has produced a number of tools based on its regular data collection activities and drone flights. The package of November 2018 is based on [NPM Site Assessment 13](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/iom-bangladesh-needs-and-population-monitoring-npm-round-13-site-assessment) (as of 20 November) and NPM most updated drone imagery (as of 26 September). Here below, the complete package by camp: SW Map package KMZ file Drone image The full image and shapefiles are available at this [link](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/iom-npm-cox-bazar-uav-imagery).
